notes.title: The launcher and the game start again on Linux.
notes.text: The previous update left out files the Linux launcher and game need, so neither started. If your launcher no longer opens, download it again from the download page: this time the update brings everything.

notes.title: The game opens on its main menu.
notes.text: Launched from the launcher, the game now waits on the main menu instead of jumping to the play screen by itself. Joining a friend's lobby from the launcher still takes you straight there.
